name: vsc-zed-plugin
description: Zed-like layout for VS Code with multi-agent sessions (Claude Code, Codex, Agy, Kilo Code).

zedLayout.enabled.description: Enable the Zed-like Agent Workspace extension features.

zedLayout.layout.scope.description: Where `Apply Zed Layout` writes settings: ask each time, User settings, or Workspace settings.

zedLayout.layout.confirmBeforeApply.description: Ask for confirmation before changing settings.

zedLayout.layout.activityBarLocation.description: Activity Bar location applied by the preset.

zedLayout.layout.hideBreadcrumbs.description: Hide breadcrumbs when applying the preset.

zedLayout.layout.applyTheme.description: Also switch the color theme when applying the preset.

zedLayout.layout.theme.description: Color theme applied by the preset (when `zedLayout.layout.applyTheme` is enabled).

zedLayout.typography.enabled.description: Apply typography settings (fonts, line height, ligatures) as part of the preset.

zedLayout.typography.fontFamily.default: 'IBM Plex Mono', 'Lilex', Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
zedLayout.typography.fontFamily.description: Editor font family applied by the preset.

zedLayout.typography.fontSize.description: Editor font size applied by the preset.

zedLayout.typography.lineHeight.description: Editor line height applied by the preset (values below 8 are a multiplier of font size).

zedLayout.typography.ligatures.description: Enable font ligatures in the editor.

zedLayout.typography.applyToTerminal.description: Also apply the font family and size to the integrated terminal.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run build
scripts.test:unit: npm run compile-tests && mocha --ui tdd out/test/layoutPreset.test.js out/test/layoutBackup.test.js out/test/themeContrast.test.js out/test/typography.test.js
